## DS-400 Day 3

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Making Visualizations

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vembedr)
library(ggplot2)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
df <- read_csv("healthcare-dataset-stroke-data.csv")
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

## Bar Chart

```{r}

stroke_status <- df %>% 
  count(hypertension, gender) %>% 
  group_by(hypertension)

stroke_status

```

```{r}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = gender, fill = factor(hypertension))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Stroke Count by Gender", x = "Gender", y = "Number of Patients") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = age, fill = factor(hypertension))) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(title = "Stroke Count by Age", x = "Age", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = df, aes( x = factor(stroke), fill = factor(stroke), y = avg_glucose_level)) +
    geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = factor(hypertension), fill = factor(stroke))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Stroke Count by Hypertension", x = "Hypertension", y = "Number of Patients") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = factor(heart_disease), fill = factor(stroke))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Stroke Count by Heart Disease", x = "Heart Disease", y = "Number of Patients") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Probability Portion

## P(B)

```{r}
probability_stroke <- patients %>% 
  count(stroke) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n))
```

### P(A\|B)

```{r}
patients <- df
patients %>%
  count(stroke, hypertension) %>%
  group_by(stroke) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n))
```

```{r}
probability_hypertension_given_stroke <- patients %>%
  count(stroke, hypertension) %>%
  group_by(stroke) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>%
  filter(stroke == 1, hypertension == 1) %>%
  pull(percent)
```

### P(A)

```{r}
patients %>%
  count(hypertension) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n))
```

```{r}
probability_hypertension <- patients %>%
  count(hypertension) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>%
  filter(hypertension == 1) %>%
  pull(percent)
```

### P(B\|A)

```{r}
probability_stroke_given_hypertension <- (probability_hypertension_given_stroke * probability_stroke) / probability_hypertension
probability_stroke_given_hypertension
```
